AI.conclusion: 相图包含纯环流区、低掺杂共存相、高掺杂纯超导态和关联金属态。

title: Orientational order on non-orientable domains
summary: We study the statistical properties of passive and active many-body systems with orientational degrees of freedom on non-orientable domains. By rephrasing topological constraints as non-local symmetry relations on an orientable double-cover, we show that non-orientability eliminates global rotational soft modes without acting like an external field. In a passive XY model, this results in topological caging, where orientational fluctuations that exhibit conventional diffusive behavior on a torus saturate on a Klein bottle to a finite value that we compute exactly in the thermodynamic limit. In models of active self-propelled particles with orientational degrees of freedom, topological caging persists despite continuously changing interaction neighborhoods. In an active Ising spin model, non-orientability enforces the coexistence of ordered anti-parallel domains with vanishing global polar order, a state that is absent on orientable domains.

AI.tldr: 研究不可定向域上具有取向自由度的被动与主动多体系统的统计性质，通过将拓扑约束重述为可定向双覆盖上的非局域对称关系，揭示不可定向性消除全局旋转软模的机制。
AI.motivation: 探讨拓扑（不可定向性）如何影响多体系统中取向自由度的集体行为，区别于外场作用。
AI.method: 将拓扑约束重述为可定向双覆盖上的非局域对称关系；分析被动XY模型、主动自驱动粒子模型及主动Ising自旋模型。
AI.result: 被动XY模型中，环面上呈常规扩散行为的取向涨落在Klein瓶上饱和至有限值（精确计算）；主动自驱动粒子模型中拓扑笼效应持续存在；主动Ising模型中不可定向性强制有序反平行畴共存，全局极序消失。
AI.conclusion: 不可定向性通过消除全局旋转软模产生拓扑笼效应，在被动与主动多体系统中普遍存在，并可诱导可定向域上不存在的相态。

title: High-fidelity k$\cdot$p representations of first-principles electronic band structures through covariant renormalization
summary: The k$\cdot$p method can be applied directly to first-principles energies and momentum matrix elements, but the resulting models converge slowly with the number of bands and are inexact wherever the underlying Hamiltonian is nonlocal. We show that both limitations can be largely removed by renormalizing the eigenvalue spectra of the Hermitian momentum matrices. These spectra are gauge invariant, and are identical for symmetry-related Cartesian components, hence scaling the recurring magnitudes provides a modest set of parameters that preserves degeneracies and crystal symmetry without needing to construct a symmetry-adapted basis. We choose to renormalize the models against reference eigenvalues and band velocities on rays out of a high-symmetry point. For GaP, a 15-band model can reproduce the band structure in the near-gap reference regions within a few meV. For zincblende and wurtzite AlN, similar accuracy requires 30- or 66-band models, which in the case of zincblende is traced to the strong warping in the [110] direction. The scheme readily generalizes to rocksalt PbTe, which includes spin-orbit coupling, and has L-centered valence and conduction band extrema. Further, we demonstrate, for GaP, how compact four-band Hamiltonians can be obtained by downfolding within the same renormalization scheme. Moreover, by changing the fitting regime to encompass the entire Brillouin zone, the scheme can be used to generate full-zone models that reproduce the density of states. The practical utility is illustrated with a 59-band k.p model for GaP, which can be evaluated on meshes far denser than the reference calculation, that in turn can be used both to resolve fine features in the density of states and to compute the hole conductivity at low temperature.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过重正化厄米动量矩阵本征值谱来改进k·p方法的新方案，能有效克服收敛慢和非局域哈密顿量不精确的问题，构建出高精度的紧凑k·p模型。
AI.motivation: 传统k·p方法直接应用于第一性原理能量和动量矩阵元时，模型随能带数收敛缓慢，且在哈密顿量非局域处结果不精确。作者希望同时解决这两个局限。
AI.method: 对厄米动量矩阵的本征值谱进行重正化。这些谱具有规范不变性，且对称相关笛卡尔分量谱相同，因此只需对重复幅值进行缩放即可用少量参数保持简并和晶体对称性，无需构造对称适配基。以高对称点发出的射线上的参考本征值和能带速度为基准进行拟合。还可通过同一重正化方案下折叠获得紧凑四能带哈密顿量，并调整拟合区域至整个布里渊区生成全区模型。
AI.result: GaP的15能带模型可在近带隙参考区以几meV精度重现能带结构；纤锌矿和闪锌矿AlN需30或66能带模型，闪锌矿的困难源于[110]方向的强翘曲。方案可推广到含自旋轨道耦合、以L点为中心的PbTe。59能带GaP模型可在远密于参考计算的网格上求解，用于分辨态密度精细结构和计算低温空穴电导率。
AI.conclusion: 该重正化方案能大幅减少k·p模型所需能带数并保持精度，可推广至多种晶体结构和含自旋轨道耦合体系，支持紧凑模型、全区模型构建及高密度网格上的实用计算。

title: A substrate booster for P-type 2D ferromagnetic semiconductor
summary: Spin transistors with its both charge and spin properties tuned via electrostatic gating are believed capable for widespread use, which however have proven challenging due to the extreme rareness of their physical base -- magnetic semiconductors. The latter are limited within very few systems including diluted magnetic semiconductors (DMS) and two-dimensional ferromagnetic semiconductors (2D-FMS), and known to suffer from inadequate gate-tunability of their electric and/or magnetic properties. Here, we show a substrate engineering paradigm by interfacing few-layered Cr$_{2}$Ge$_{2}$Te$_{6}$ (FL-CGT) with an antiferromagnetic insulator CrOCl. Owing to the subtle interfacial charge transfer couplings, CGT can be drastically turned from an ambipolar semiconductor into a high performance P-type semiconductor. When cooled below the Curie temperature, the ON-OFF ratio in such substrate-boosted FMS field-effect transistor (FET) reaches 10$^{5}$ with its coercive field $H_{c}$ of magnetic hysteresis loop tunable by a factor of more than 200$\%$, enabling {gate-assisted magnetic switching in the prototype semiconducting spin transistor architecture}. A crossover from critical power-law scaling to a dual power-law behaviour under heavy hole doping was further observed. Our findings {signify} an efficient interfacial charge transfer and electrically modulated magnetic anisotropy energy supported by calculations. This high performance P-type FMS-FET system suggests that active substrate-boosting paradigm might be a powerful path for the investigation of future gate-tunable spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 通过将少层Cr2Ge2Te6与反铁磁绝缘体CrOCl界面耦合的衬底工程，把原本双极性半导体转变为高性能P型铁磁半导体，实现栅极辅助磁开关与电场调控磁各向异性。
AI.motivation: 自旋晶体管需同时电控电荷与自旋，但磁性半导体极为稀缺（仅稀释磁半导体与二维铁磁半导体），且其电学/磁学性质的栅极可调性不足。本文旨在通过衬底工程设计解决二维铁磁半导体的栅极调控难题。
AI.method: 将少层Cr2Ge2Te6 (FL-CGT) 与反铁磁绝缘体CrOCl构筑异质界面，利用界面电荷转移耦合进行衬底工程，并结合计算分析界面电荷转移与电场调制磁各向异性能。
AI.result: 界面电荷转移使CGT从双极性半导体显著转变为高性能P型半导体；低于居里温度时，衬底增强型FMS-FET的ON-OFF比达10^5，磁滞回线矫顽场Hc可调幅度超过200%；实现栅极辅助磁开关；重空穴掺杂下观察到从临界幂律标度到双幂律行为的转变。
AI.conclusion: 该高性能P型FMS-FET体系表明，主动衬底增强范式可能是研究未来栅极可调自旋电子器件的有力途径。

title: A model of grain growth in UN integrating molecular dynamics, phase-field modeling, and uncertainty quantification
summary: Grain growth kinetics and grain-boundary (GB) properties in uranium mononitride (UN) are investigated through an integrated multiscale framework combining molecular dynamics (MD), phase-field modeling, and surrogate-assisted uncertainty quantification. MD simulations yield GB energies for 27 symmetric tilt boundaries from 0--2000~K, which are consistent with available DFT values. The average GB energy is nearly temperature-independent below 1000~K and increases at higher temperatures. A mechanistic pore-drag model applied to the only available grain growth dataset for actinide nitrides yields a mobility reduction factor of $s \approx 0.93$--$0.99$, statistically indistinguishable from unity, confirming that pore drag is negligible under the experimental conditions. The intrinsic GB mobility is therefore extracted directly from the effective mobility, yielding $M_0 = 2.05\times10^{-15}$~m$^4$/(J$\cdot$s) and $Q_M = 0.89$~eV. Phase-field simulations conducted from 1500--2000~K confirm normal curvature-driven grain growth, with grain size distributions converging to the Hillert-like form. A surrogate-assisted global sensitivity analysis---combining principal component analysis, Gaussian process regression, and Sobol decomposition---reveals that the mobility prefactor $M_0$ dominates output variance at all times, followed by the activation energy $Q_M$, while the GB energy $γ$ contributes minimally. These results establish the first quantitative grain growth framework for UN and identify the reduction of uncertainty in $M_0$ and $Q_M$ as the highest-priority target for future experimental efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过MD、相场模拟与代理辅助不确定性量化相结合的多尺度框架，研究UN的晶粒生长动力学与晶界性质，首次建立UN定量晶粒生长框架。
AI.motivation: 铀单氮化物（UN）是重要的核燃料，但其晶粒生长动力学和晶界性质缺乏定量认识，尤其是晶界能、晶界迁移率及孔洞拖曳等关键参数不明，制约了燃料性能预测。现有晶粒生长数据稀少，亟需系统性的多尺度研究。
AI.method: 构建MD+相场+代理辅助UQ的多尺度框架。MD计算0–2000 K下27个对称倾斜晶界的晶界能；用孔洞拖曳模型分析唯一可用的锕系氮化物晶粒生长数据；相场模拟1500–2000 K生长；代理辅助全局敏感性分析结合PCA、高斯过程回归和Sobol分解。
AI.result: MD所得晶界能与DFT一致，平均晶界能在1000 K以下几乎不随温度变化，高温升高；孔洞拖曳因子s≈0.93–0.99，与1无统计差异，表明孔洞拖曳可忽略；提取本征迁移率M0=2.05×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴/(J·s)、QM=0.89 eV；相场模拟显示正常曲率驱动生长，晶粒尺寸分布趋近Hillert形式；敏感性分析表明M0主导输出方差，其次QM，γ贡献最小。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了UN首个定量晶粒生长框架，明确降低M0和QM的不确定性是未来实验的最高优先级目标。

title: Optically induced metallic state with persistent monoclinic symmetry in NdNiO$_3$
summary: Understanding whether electronic and structural order remain coupled under nonequilibrium conditions is a central challenge in correlated materials. Here, we simultaneously track metallicity and symmetry across the photoinduced insulator-to-metal transition in NdNiO$_3$ using time-resolved optical reflectivity and symmetry-sensitive second-harmonic generation. We find that metallic reflectivity emerges at significantly lower excitation fluence than restoration of the orthorhombic high-temperature symmetry. As a result, optical excitation stabilizes a metastable state that combines the reflectivity of the metallic phase with the monoclinic symmetry of the insulating phase, revealing an optically induced monoclinic metal. Only at substantially higher fluences does the symmetry fully recover to that of the high-temperature phase. These results demonstrate a nonequilibrium decoupling of metallicity and structural symmetry and establish simultaneous multiprobe spectroscopy as a powerful approach for identifying emergent phases in correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过时间分辨光学反射率与对称敏感的二次谐波产生，同步追踪NdNiO₃光诱导绝缘体-金属转变，发现金属性与结构对称性在非平衡条件下解耦，产生一种"单斜金属"亚稳相。
AI.motivation: 理解电子序与结构序在非平衡条件下是否保持耦合，是关联材料研究中的核心挑战。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨光学反射率与对称敏感的二次谐波产生（SHG）同步探测NdNiO₃光诱导绝缘体-金属转变中的金属性和对称性。
AI.result: 金属反射率在显著更低的激发通量下即出现，远低于正交高温对称性恢复所需通量；由此稳定了一个兼具金属相反射率和绝缘相单斜对称性的亚稳态，即光诱导单斜金属。只有更高通量下对称性才完全恢复至高温相。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明金属性与结构对称性存在非平衡解耦，确立了同步多探针谱学作为识别关联材料中新兴相的有力手段。

title: Disordered ground states in one-dimensional exactly solvable fluids
summary: One-dimensional fluids of classical hard-core particles of diameter $a$, interacting in pairs via a soft repulsive (monotonically decreasing) potential of finite range $\varphi(x)=\varepsilon \left[ (a'-x)/(a'-a)\right]^{1/ν}$ $(a\le x\le a')$ with real positive parameters $\varepsilon$ and $ν$, are studied in an isothermal-isobaric ensemble. If $a'\le 2a$, the pairwise interactions are reduced to nearest-neighbour interactions, which allows for an exact solution of the thermal equilibrium. We focus on the $T\to 0$ ground states, specifically on the equation of state for the mean distance between nearest neighbours $l_0$ and the pair correlation function $g_0(x)$. If $\varphi(x)$ is concave $(ν\ge 1)$, there exists an ``incompressibility'' pressure $p_i=\varepsilon/(a'-a)$ such that the ground state is an equidistant chain of particles with spacing $l_0=a'$ for $0<p<p_i$ and with spacing $l_0=a$ for $p>p_i$. If $ν>1$ (strict concavity), the ground state at $p=p_i$ is disordered with $l_0=\left[ νa +(ν-1)a'\right]/(2ν-1)$ and $g_0(x)$ being a superposition of weighted Dirac delta functions over discrete positions. If $ν=1$ (linear ramp), the ground state at $p=p_i$ is disordered with $l_0=(a+a')/2$ and the continuous $g_0(x)$ is a superposition of Heaviside step functions multiplied by polynomials in $x$. The isothermal susceptibility at $T=0$ is nonzero for concave $\varphi(x)$ ($ν\ge 1$) at $p=p_i$ and, therefore, the corresponding disordered ground states are non-hyperuniform, i.e., they resemble disordered fluids at nonzero temperatures. It turns out that pair correlation functions of disordered ground states, which occur only at a single pressure $p_i$, extend their predictive power to thermodynamic states at nonzero temperatures over a wider range of pressures around $p_i$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维硬核粒子软排斥流体在等温等压系综下的精确解及其T→0基态行为。
AI.motivation: 一维流体模型具有可精确求解的优势，但软排斥势下基态结构（有序/无序转变）与超均匀性尚需系统刻画。
AI.method: 采用等温等压系综；当a'≤2a时相互作用退化为最近邻，从而获得热平衡精确解，重点分析T→0基态及等温磁化率。
AI.result: 凹势（ν≥1）存在不可压缩压强p_i=ε/(a'-a)：0<p<p_i时粒子等距排列l_0=a'，p>p_i时l_0=a。ν>1时p=p_i基态无序，l_0=[νa+(ν-1)a']/(2ν-1)，g_0为离散位置加权Dirac delta叠加；ν=1时l_0=(a+a')/2，g_0为Heaviside阶跃乘多项式叠加。
AI.conclusion: 凹势在p=p_i时零温等温磁化率非零，故无序基态非超均匀，类似非零温无序流体；且无序基态的配对关联函数可外推预测p_i附近非零温状态。

title: In-plane magnetic field control of anomalous Hall response enabled by magnetic anisotropy engineering
summary: Engineering magnetic anisotropy provides a powerful route to control magnetization orientation and unlock emerging functionalities in opto-spintronic and current-driven devices. Beyond its role in magnetization reversal, the effective anisotropy can strongly influence the magnetotransport response, offering an additional degree of freedom to tune new device functionalities. In this work, we report a magnetotransport study of a ferrimagnetic [Tb/Co]$_{\times 5}$ multilayer grown with a Tb thickness gradient, whose wedge-shaped tilts the uniaxial anisotropy axis slightly away from the film normal. Anomalous Hall resistivity measurements from 80 K to 300 K reveal a spin reorientation transition, while the angular dependence of the magnetotransport responses exposes the crucial role of the tilted anisotropy. A simplified macrospin model reproduces the full angular response across the transition and shows that the observed anomalous Hall effect when the in-plane magnetic field is applied originates from the tilt of the uniaxial anisotropy axis, which supplies a built-in symmetry-breaking mechanism, enabling in-plane field control over the out-of-plane anomalous Hall response, sign included. These findings establish tilted magnetic anisotropy as a promising route toward Hall effect-based sensor applications and highlight Tb/Co multilayers as a versatile platform for anisotropy-engineered spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有Tb厚度梯度的铁磁[Tb/Co]×5多层膜的磁输运性质，发现楔形结构使单轴各向异性轴略微偏离薄膜法线，通过宏自旋模型揭示倾斜各向异性可带来内建对称破缺，实现面内磁场对垂直异常霍尔响应的调控（含符号）。
AI.motivation: 工程化磁各向异性是控制磁化取向、解锁光自旋电子与电流驱动器件新功能的重要途径。除磁化翻转外，有效各向异性还能显著影响磁输运响应，为调控器件功能提供额外自由度，因此有必要研究倾斜各向异性对磁输运的影响。
AI.method: 采用Tb厚度梯度生长楔形铁磁[Tb/Co]×5多层膜，使单轴各向异性轴偏离薄膜法线；在80 K至300 K温度范围内进行异常霍尔电阻率测量，并测量磁输运响应的角度依赖；构建简化宏自旋模型拟合全角度响应。
AI.result: 测量揭示了自旋重取向转变；角度依赖的磁输运响应凸显了倾斜各向异性的关键作用；宏自旋模型成功复现整个转变过程的全角度响应，并表明面内磁场下的异常霍尔效应源于单轴各向异性轴的倾斜，该倾斜提供了内建对称破缺机制，从而实现面内磁场对垂直异常霍尔响应（含符号）的控制。
AI.conclusion: 倾斜磁各向异性为基于霍尔效应的传感器应用提供了有前景的路径，并凸显Tb/Co多层膜作为各向异性工程自旋电子器件的通用平台。

title: Vacancy Order and Physical Properties of a Ternary Compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe-Type Structure
summary: We report the identification and characterization of a new compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe prototype structure. Different from the Fe-square net and minor occupancy of interstitial Fe-sites in Fe1+xTe, Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is featured by a Pdsquare net and near 68% occupancy of the corresponding interstitial Fe-sites. Furthermore, noncontact atomic force microscopy and X-ray diffraction provide evidence for the existence of a 3*3*3 Pd-vacancy order in this layered material. A spin-glass ground state below Tg 40 K is identified via magnetic characterization. Electrical transport measurements show that Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is a semiconductor with a very small band gap below 10 meV. It has weak negative magnetoresistance and holelike charge carriers below room temperature. Our results demonstrate its potentials for further exploring various quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 报道了新型层状化合物Fe0.68Pd0.80Te的合成与表征，具有α-Fe1+xTe原型结构，展现自旋玻璃基态、极小带隙半导体行为及空穴型载流子。
AI.motivation: 探索与Fe1+xTe相关的新化合物，发掘其在量子现象研究中的潜力。
AI.method: 通过结构表征（非接触原子力显微镜、X射线衍射）与磁性、电输运测量对Fe0.68Pd0.80Te进行系统研究。
AI.result: Fe0.68Pd0.80Te具有Pd方形网和约68%的间隙Fe位占据，存在3×3×3的Pd空位有序；Tg≈40 K以下为自旋玻璃基态；为带隙小于10 meV的半导体，具弱负磁阻和空穴型载流子。
AI.conclusion: Fe0.68Pd0.80Te为研究多种量子现象提供了潜在平台。

title: Silicon Solar Cell Design for >30% Efficiency via Singlet Fission
summary: Singlet fission (SF) materials convert high-energy photons into multiple charge carriers, providing a route to exceed the efficiency limits of single-junction silicon solar cells without many of the complexities of multi-junction tandem designs. Following the first demonstration of an SF-enhanced silicon solar cell in 2025, there is a need to understand how SF materials can be effectively integrated into high-efficiency industrial silicon devices and translated from proof of concept to a manufacturable technology. Using coupled optical and electrical simulations, we assess the efficiency potential of several industrially relevant silicon cell architectures combined with SF materials. Interdigitated back-contact (IBC) cells offer the greatest potential for improvement due to unrestricted front-surface access and can achieve efficiencies exceeding 33%. However, performance is highly sensitive to front-surface passivation quality. Appropriate silicon design, particularly controlled surface doping and fixed interfacial charge, can mitigate recombination losses and relax passivation requirements for ultra-thin exciton-transfer layers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过光电耦合模拟评估了多种工业相关硅电池结构与单线态裂变（SF）材料集成的效率潜力，发现IBC电池提升空间最大，效率可超33%，但高度依赖前表面钝化质量。
AI.motivation: SF材料能将高能光子转化为多个电荷载流子，有望在不依赖复杂多结叠层设计的情况下突破单结硅电池效率极限。2025年首个SF增强硅电池问世后，亟需理解如何将SF材料有效集成到高效工业硅器件中并实现可制造化。
AI.method: 采用光学与电学耦合模拟，评估多种工业相关硅电池架构与SF材料结合后的效率潜力。
AI.result: 交叉指式背接触（IBC）电池因前表面无遮挡而提升潜力最大，效率可超过33%；但性能对前表面钝化质量高度敏感。合理的硅设计（尤其是受控表面掺杂与固定界面电荷）可缓解复合损失，放宽对超薄激子传输层的钝化要求。
AI.conclusion: SF材料集成到工业硅电池具有显著效率潜力，IBC结构最具前景，但需通过优化硅表面掺杂与界面电荷来降低对钝化的依赖，推动其从概念验证走向可制造技术。

title: Rare-History Transitions in Temporally Random Integrable Quantum Circuits
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Supplemental Material will be submitted separately. This is an initial draft, and comments are welcome
summary: We study current fluctuations in a temporally random integrable quantum circuit. Commutativity reduces every drive history exactly to its layer composition, turning annealed fluctuations into a competition between current gain and the large-deviation cost of rare compositions. For each fixed composition, homogeneous thermodynamic Bethe ansatz dressing supplemented by ballistic fluctuation theory yields the conditional current statistics. Their annealed large-deviation contraction predicts a first-order switch between two dominant history classes, terminating on a line of regular cusp endpoints. Finite-time analysis shows how the switch is rounded. Thus temporal randomness can act as an emergent order-parameter-like coordinate in trajectory space.

AI.tldr: 研究时间随机可积量子电路中的电流涨落，利用交换性将驱动历史约化为层组成，预报两类主导历史之间的一阶切换。
AI.motivation: 探索时间随机性如何影响可积量子电路中的电流涨落，并揭示其在轨迹空间中作为类序参量坐标的作用。
AI.method: 利用交换性将每个驱动历史精确约化为层组成；对固定组成，用均匀热力学Bethe拟设缀饰并结合弹道涨落理论求条件电流统计；再用退火大偏差收缩分析。
AI.result: 退火大偏差收缩预言两类主导历史之间的一阶切换，终止于一条正则尖点端点线；有限时间分析显示该切换如何被圆滑。
AI.conclusion: 时间随机性可作为轨迹空间中涌现的类序参量坐标。

title: Fingerprints of Excitonic Collective Modes in the Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
summary: The two-dimensional homogeneous electron gas (2D HEG) is a prototype system of fundamental interest that can be realized experimentally over a wide range of densities. Here, we investigate its collective charge excitations at low densities, using time-dependent density functional theory. We demonstrate that, beyond traditional plasmons, new collective excitonic modes emerge for a Wigner-Seitz radius larger than $r_{\mathrm s} \approx 1$. These excitonic modes leave characteristic fingerprints in experimentally accessible quantities, namely, asymmetric peak structures in the loss function and very strong Friedel-like oscillations in the static linear density response that increase when the system approaches a regime of instability. Indeed, at low enough densities the collective modes cross the zero energy axis, indicating an instability of the paramagnetic 2D HEG towards the formation of a charge-density-wave phase with excitonic origin. These findings provide valuable insights for the experimental detection of excitonic collective modes in tunable 2D electron systems and contribute to the fundamental understanding of many-body effects in low-density electron gases.

AI.tldr: 用含时密度泛函理论研究低密度二维均匀电子气的集体电荷激发，发现除传统等离激元外，还存在新的集体激子模式，并预言其可实验探测的特征及向电荷密度波相的不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 二维均匀电子气是可在宽密度范围内实验实现的基本原型系统，理解其低密度集体激发对多体效应和实验探测具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）研究低密度二维均匀电子气的集体电荷激发。
AI.result: 发现当Wigner-Seitz半径 r_s ≳ 1 时出现新的集体激子模式；在损失函数中表现为不对称峰结构，在静态线性密度响应中表现为强烈的Friedel-like振荡，且随系统接近不稳定区而增强；在足够低密度下集体模式穿越零能轴。
AI.conclusion: 该零能穿越表明顺磁二维均匀电子气存在由激子起源驱动的、向电荷密度波相转变的不稳定性；研究为二维电子系统中激子集体模式的实验探测提供了依据，并加深了对低密度电子气多体效应的理解。

title: Phase-Controlled Majorana Zero Modes in Altermagnetic Topological-Insulator Josephson Junctions
summary: We exploit facet-dependent Andreev phase shifts to control topological superconductivity with a phase bias in a three-dimensional altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junction. In the weak link between two conventional s-wave superconductors, the d-wave altermagnetic order produces facet-dependent momentum shifts of the surface Dirac cones. The resulting net momentum of the states involved in Andreev reflection generates additional propagation phases that differ between facets. Consequently, the facet-resolved Andreev spectra exhibit gap closings at distinct phase biases, giving rise to topological superconducting regimes that host Majorana zero modes(MZMs). We further show that tuning the phase bias controls the spatial localization of these modes. The associated topological superconducting transitions are only weakly affected by moderate variations in the chemical potential, obviating the need for fine-tuning to the Dirac point. Our results establish a platform for realizing and spatially controlling MZMs by tuning the superconducting phase bias in altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junctions.

AI.tldr: 利用交变磁性拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森结中的面依赖Andreev相移，通过相位偏置调控拓扑超导并实现马约拉纳零模的空间控制。
AI.motivation: 探索无需精细调节、可灵活调控拓扑超导与马约拉纳零模的新机制与平台。
AI.method: 在三维交变磁性拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森结中，分析d波交变磁序导致的面依赖表面狄拉克锥动量移动及Andreev反射的额外传播相位。
AI.result: 不同晶面Andreev谱在不同相位偏置下闭合，产生承载MZM的拓扑超导区；相位偏置可控制MZM的空间局域；拓扑相变对化学势中等变化不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该体系为在交变磁性拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森结中通过相位偏置实现并空间调控MZM提供了平台。

title: U-Shaped Fermi-Level Dependence of Point-Defect Aggregation Enthalpy in Silicon
summary: Point defects govern the electronic and structural behavior of silicon, yet their configuration and energy depend on both the charge state and the Fermi level (EF). Using an unbiased global structure search with first-principles calculations, we screened more than 1,500 candidate structures, covering intrinsic defects and C, H, O, N, P, and B impurities in charge states from -2 to +2. The reaction enthalpy of defect aggregation depends on EF in a U shape, being strongest where the net charge transferred during the reaction vanishes and weaker toward both band edges. This U arises because complexes are more charge-neutral than their isolated constituents, so the net charge transfer changes sign across the gap. The point where this sign change occurs is set by the transition levels of the specific defects. For typical reactions, the driving force is tunable by 0.3-0.5 eV, which shifts the equilibrium complex concentration by five to eight orders of magnitude at room temperature. Our results make the Fermi level a practical lever for defect engineering in as-grown and irradiated silicon.

AI.tldr: 硅中点缺陷的构型与能量依赖电荷态和费米能级；通过全局结构搜索+第一性原理筛选1500+结构，发现缺陷聚集反应焓随费米能级呈U形，驱动力可调0.3-0.5 eV，使复合体平衡浓度在室温下变化5-8个数量级。
AI.motivation: 点缺陷决定硅的电子与结构行为，但其构型与能量同时取决于电荷态与费米能级EF，这一耦合关系尚未被系统理解，限制了缺陷工程的可控性。
AI.method: 采用无偏全局结构搜索结合第一性原理计算，筛选超1500个候选结构，涵盖本征缺陷及C、H、O、N、P、B杂质，电荷态从-2到+2。
AI.result: 缺陷聚集反应焓随EF呈U形：当反应中净电荷转移为零时最强，向两侧带边减弱；原因是复合体比孤立组分更电中性，净电荷转移在带隙中变号，变号点由缺陷的跃迁能级决定。典型反应驱动力可调0.3-0.5 eV，室温下复合体平衡浓度变化5-8个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 费米能级可作为硅（原生与辐照）缺陷工程的实用调控手段。

title: Topological band structure of excitons in octochlore KTb$_{3}$F$_{10}$: an analog of the Luttinger Semimetal
summary: Understanding the symmetry and topology of band structures in crystalline solids has been among the defining themes of a generation of condensed matter physicists, with implications across many different platforms including electronic bands, photonic crystals, phonons and magnetic excitations. In the latter systems, there is usually magnetic long-range order and time reversal symmetry breaking. Here we further enrich the possible band structures available to magnetic systems by examining dispersive crystal field excitations above a ground state that is a simple product of singlets. In these systems, there is an interplay of magnetic interactions and band topology with both crystal and time reversal symmetries. Using high-resolution neutron spectroscopy we reveal the dispersion relations of bosonic excitons in KTb$_{3}$F$_{10}$, an experimental realization of the octochlore lattice. We show that there are pinch point features in the scattering intensity. The dominant coupling in this system is the long-range magnetostatic dipolar interaction, whose singularity at the zone center is passed onto the scattering intensity. However, the pinch points survive when the range of the dipoles is truncated to finite shell number in the form of a three-band quadratic band touching protected by cubic symmetry. This model, which is related to the Luttinger semi-metal, provides a general long wavelength model for the emergence of pinch point scattering intensity encompassing also the true long-range dipolar model.

AI.tldr: 研究KTb₃F₁₀（八氯晶格实现）中磁激发（玻色激子）的色散关系，揭示磁相互作用与能带拓扑的关联，并解释散射强度中pinch point的起源。
AI.motivation: 磁系统中通常存在磁长程有序与时间反演对称破缺，其能带结构可能性尚待拓展；本文考察位于单态简单乘积基态之上的色散晶体场激发，探索磁相互作用与能带拓扑（结合晶格与时间反演对称性）之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 利用高分辨率中子散射测量KTb₃F₁₀（八氯晶格的实验实现）中玻色激子的色散关系；并构建理论模型分析长程磁静偶极相互作用及其在截断到有限壳层时的行为。
AI.result: 观察到散射强度中的pinch point特征。主导耦合为长程磁静偶极相互作用，其在zone center的奇异性传递给散射强度；但当偶极作用截断至有限壳层时，pinch point仍以受立方对称性保护的三带二次能带接触形式存在。该模型与Luttinger半金属相关。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了pinch point散射强度出现的一般长波模型，同时涵盖真正的长程偶极模型，为磁系统能带拓扑研究提供了新视角。

title: Work as a function of protocol duration for the efficient erasure of an underdamped memory: isothermal to adiabatic transition
summary: We use evolutionary reinforcement learning to determine efficient time-dependent erasure protocols for an underdamped cantilever moving in a double-well potential, an experimental realization of a 1-bit memory. We investigate how the mean work $\langle W \rangle $ needed to erase a bit scales as a function of the protocol duration $τ$. We find two regimes, depending on how $τ$ compares to the relaxation time of the system $t_r$. For $τ\gg t_r$, the quasistatic isothermal regime, we recover Landauer's bound plus an overhead that scales as $1/τ$, similar to the overdamped case. By contrast, for $τ<t_r$ erasure becomes adiabatic and $\langle W \rangle$ grows more slowly than in the isothermal case. This growth is bounded from below as $1/τ$, which we derive using a gedanken optimal protocol. Finally, comparison with overdamped erasure shows that learned protocols can outperform protocols that are optimal subject to equilibrium boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用演化强化学习为过阻尼悬臂梁（双势阱中的1比特存储器）设计高效的时间依赖擦除协议，发现平均擦除功随协议时长τ呈现两种标度区制，并揭示了欠阻尼擦除可优于传统平衡边界条件下的最优协议。
AI.motivation: 探究1比特存储器在有限时间下擦除所需最小功如何随协议时长变化，比较欠阻尼与过阻尼情形的差异，并寻找超越传统最优协议的高效擦除策略。
AI.method: 采用演化强化学习，为双势阱中的欠阻尼悬臂梁自动搜索时间依赖的擦除协议，并分析平均功⟨W⟩随协议时长τ的标度行为，与系统弛豫时间t_r进行比较。
AI.result: 当τ≫t_r（准静态等温区制），⟨W⟩恢复Landauer极限加上随1/τ衰减的额外开销，与过阻尼情形类似；当τ<t_r时擦除变为绝热过程，⟨W⟩增长更慢；其下界由理想最优协议推导为1/τ。此外，与过阻尼擦除相比，学习到的协议能够超越满足平衡边界条件的最优协议。
AI.conclusion: 欠阻尼有限时间擦除存在两种标度区制，绝热擦除比等温情形更高效，且强化学习可发现优于传统平衡边界最优协议的擦除方案。

title: Enhancing charge stability of Ge quantum well heterostructures via SiGe layer composition engineering
summary: Composition modulation is a powerful technique for designing materials with tailored properties, fueling the development of advanced semiconductor devices. In this work, we have implemented this technique into Ge quantum well heterostructures, offering a promising avenue to address the critical challenge of charge stability in spin qubit devices. Harnessing the atomic-scale precision of molecular beam epitaxy, we have engineered the band structure of the SiGe top barrier via graded composition modulation, thereby reducing charge accumulation states at the SiGe-dielectric interface and strengthening the effective confinement to the hole gases in the Ge quantum wells. The enhanced charge stability of composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures is confirmed in Hall devices, featuring an enlarged stable gate voltage range. We have further fabricated quantum dot devices from the composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures and observed remarkably low charge noise with an averaged amplitude of $0.46\,\mathrm{μeV}/\mathrm{\sqrt{Hz}}$ at $1\,\mathrm{Hz}$---the lowest reported value for Ge quantum wells grown on silicon. This exceptional charge stability of the quantum dots persists in the few-hole regime, with no observable voltage drift over $\sim$hours. With reduced charge noise and enhanced energy stability, composition-modulated SiGe/Ge heterostructures exhibit significant potential for applications in building high-performance quantum devices, including spin qubits with a long coherence time.

AI.tldr: 通过组分梯度调制SiGe顶势垒能带，减少界面电荷积累并增强Ge量子阱空穴限制，从而显著降低电荷噪声，实现Ge量子点最低报道值0.46 μeV/√Hz的电荷稳定性。
AI.motivation: 自旋量子比特器件面临电荷稳定性的关键挑战，需要设计具有定制性能的材料来提升电荷稳定性。
AI.method: 利用分子束外延的原子级精度，对SiGe顶势垒进行组分梯度调制来工程化能带结构，减少SiGe-介电界面电荷积累态，增强对Ge量子阱中空穴气的有效限制；并用Hall器件和量子点器件进行验证。
AI.result: Hall器件显示出更大的稳定栅压范围；量子点器件获得平均幅度0.46 μeV/√Hz（1 Hz）的极低电荷噪声，是硅上生长的Ge量子阱的最低报道值；在少空穴区稳定保持，数小时内无电压漂移。
AI.conclusion: 组分调制的SiGe/Ge异质结构因降低的电荷噪声和增强的能量稳定性，在构建高性能量子器件（如长相干时间自旋量子比特）方面具有重要潜力。

title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors
summary: In order to understand the unexpected similarity and the correlated behavior in kagome superconductor families AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = K, Rb, Cs) and ATi$_3$Bi$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), we investigate the Hartree-scale local electronic structure of these systems. Our result indicates that V and Ti ions are both of 2+ valence such that the corresponding itinerant carrier densities are similar, and the difference in electron count is instead reflected in their quantum fluctuating ionic magnetic moments. However, due to the frustrated lattice geometry of these materials, such local moments are difficult to experimentally observe via standard probes. For verification, we systematically introduce nonmagnetic Sn impurities to locally relieve the geometric frustration and experimentally demonstrate the existence of well-defined local magnetic moments via magnetic susceptibility and muon spin rotation or relaxation ($μ$SR) measurements. All experiments discover a systematic increase of magnetic susceptibility upon increasing nonmagnetic impurity level. Our discovered ionic moments suggest a paradigm shift from the existing itinerant carrier-only picture to one incorporating strong correlation from local ionic spins. The associated interatomic and local-itinerant correlations offer a solid ground for the emergence of the observed rich correlated behavior in this new family of superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究kagome超导体AV₃Sb₅和ATi₃Bi₅的局域电子结构，提出V/Ti离子为2+价、存在量子涨落局域磁矩，并通过非磁性Sn掺杂实验验证。
AI.motivation: 理解AV₃Sb₅与ATi₃Bi₅两族材料间意外的相似性和关联行为，揭示其丰富的关联物理起源。
AI.method: 计算Hartree尺度局域电子结构；用非磁性Sn杂质解除几何阻挫，通过磁化率与μSR测量验证局域磁矩。
AI.result: V和Ti均为2+价，巡游载流子密度相近，差异体现在量子涨落局域磁矩；掺杂后磁化率系统性随杂质增加而升高，证实局域磁矩存在。
AI.conclusion: 提出从纯巡游载流子图像向含局域自旋强关联图像的范式转变，为理解该新超导家族的关联行为提供基础。

title: High-Performance Scaled P-Type SnOx Transistor by Atomic Layer Deposition with CFET Integration
summary: The development of high-performance p-type oxide semiconductors is essential for realizing complementary logic for monolithic 3D integration, yet p-type oxide semiconductors still exhibit substantially inferior performance compared with their n-type counterparts. In this work, we demonstrate high-performance p-type SnOx transistors by atomic layer deposition (ALD), as back-end-of-line compatible devices for monolithic 3D integration. The SnOx transistors exhibit high field-effect mobility of 6.9 cm2/Vs, low subthreshold swing (SS) of 185 mV/dec, decent on/off ratio (ION/IOFF) of 1.8*104 and high bias stability. By scaling the channel length down to 80 nm, a high on-current of 38.7 mA/mm at VDS of -1 V is achieved. It is understood that precursor and reaction engineering to suppress Sn4+ component in SnOx film are the key for performance enhancement. Furthermore, a complementary field-effect transistor with ALD SnOx p-FET vertically stacking on ALD In2O3 n-FET is also demonstrated, achieving maximum voltage gain of 21 V/V at VDD of 4 V. These findings suggest ALD SnOx as a promising candidate for scaled high-performance BEOL p-type transistors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过原子层沉积(ALD)制备高性能p型SnOx晶体管，利用前驱体和反应工程抑制Sn4+含量，实现高迁移率与良好偏压稳定性，并构建了垂直堆叠的互补场效应晶体管(CFET)。
AI.motivation: 实现单片3D集成所需的互补逻辑，需要高性能p型氧化物半导体，但目前p型氧化物半导体性能远逊于n型对应器件，因此亟需开发高性能p型氧化物晶体管。
AI.method: 采用原子层沉积(ALD)制备作为后段制程(BEOL)兼容的p型SnOx晶体管，通过前驱体与反应工程抑制SnOx薄膜中Sn4+组分以增强性能；并将沟道长度缩小至80 nm，还将ALD SnOx p-FET与ALD In2O3 n-FET垂直堆叠构建互补场效应晶体管。
AI.result: SnOx晶体管实现6.9 cm2/Vs的场效应迁移率、185 mV/dec的亚阈值摆幅、1.8×10^4的开关比及高偏压稳定性；沟道缩短至80 nm时在VDS=-1 V下获得38.7 mA/mm的高开态电流；垂直堆叠CFET在VDD=4 V下实现最大电压增益21 V/V。
AI.conclusion: ALD SnOx有望成为可缩放高性能BEOL p型晶体管的候选材料。

title: Robust Spin-1 Haldane Topology under Itinerant Doping
summary: We study itinerant hole doping of the spin-$1$ Haldane symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase in two $t$--$J$ chains coupled by ferromagnetic (FM) Hund exchange. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show that string order, a finite spin gap, and the Haldane entanglement structure coexist over a broad doping range. Combined with entanglement-entropy scaling consistent with a single gapless charge mode, these results support a metallic doped Haldane SPT with a $C1S0$ low-energy description. At low doping, short-range charge correlations reduce the density of spin-$1/2$ defect rungs, whereas at larger doping their positions become nearly uncorrelated while their spins are collectively incorporated into the correlated spin sector. The doped Haldane SPT terminates in a fully spin-polarized FM phase, which forms a reentrant pocket at high doping in the global phase diagram. Dilute-limit analyses trace the two FM boundaries to spin--charge factorization at weak Hund coupling and to rung-triplet binding with reduced pair mobility at strong Hund coupling. Our results show how mobile carriers reorganize the Haldane spin structure while preserving its characteristic signatures.

AI.tldr: 研究两条由铁磁Hund交换耦合的t-J链中自旋1 Haldane SPT相的空穴掺杂，发现存在金属性掺杂Haldane SPT相（C1S0），并在高掺杂处出现再入铁磁相。
AI.motivation: 探究Haldane对称保护拓扑相在载流子掺杂下如何演变，以及其拓扑自旋结构能否在金属态中保持。
AI.method: 对两条铁磁Hund交换耦合的t-J链进行密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算，并辅以稀薄极限分析。
AI.result: 在宽掺杂范围内弦序、有限自旋能隙与Haldane纠缠结构共存，纠缠熵标度符合单一无能隙电荷模式；低掺杂时短程电荷关联降低自旋1/2缺陷梯密度，高掺杂时缺陷位置近乎无关联而自旋并入关联自旋扇区；掺杂Haldane SPT最终终止于完全自旋极化铁磁相，并在高掺杂形成再入口袋；两个铁磁边界分别源于弱Hund耦合的自旋-电荷分离与强Hund耦合的梯三重态束缚。
AI.conclusion: 移动载流子可在保持Haldane特征信号的同时重组其自旋结构，支持金属性掺杂Haldane SPT的存在。

title: Certified reduced-basis emulation of conformal field theories on the fuzzy sphere
summary: Fuzzy-sphere regularization gives numerical access to three-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs), but locating one requires testing for criticality across the parameter space of microscopic couplings. We reduce the search cost by about two orders of magnitude, combining an exact diagonalization based on states having definite total angular momentum with a certified reduced-basis emulator that reconstructs energies, observables and their derivatives continuously across the couplings from a handful of exact solutions per system size. The combination reproduces the published ground-state-energy analysis of the fuzzy-sphere Ising model and the published conformal data of a three-flavor fuzzy-sphere realization of the O(2) Wilson--Fisher CFT, including quantities defined by parameter derivatives. Applied to the O(2) model with no CFT input, the ground-state-energy criterion locates the critical coupling to within half a percent of a density matrix renormalization group value obtained on systems more than twice the size, and maps the critical line of the model across the coupling plane. Ground-state criteria locate the critical line robustly, but the point they select along it is weakly determined, and the computed dimensions come closest to the bootstrap elsewhere along the line.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合角动量守恒的精确对角化与可认证降维基模拟器，将模糊球CFT的临界点搜索成本降低约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 模糊球正则化虽能数值求解三维CFT，但需在微观耦合参数空间内测试临界性，搜索成本高昂。
AI.method: 基于确定总角动量态的精确对角化，配合可认证的降维基（reduced-basis）模拟器，从每个系统尺寸的少量精确解连续重建能量、可观测量及其导数。
AI.result: 复现了模糊球Ising模型的基态能量分析及三味O(2) Wilson-Fisher CFT的共形数据（含参数导数定义量）；在无CFT输入的O(2)模型中，基态能量判据定位临界耦合精度达0.5%以内（对比尺寸两倍以上的DMRG值），并绘制出耦合平面上的临界线。
AI.conclusion: 基态判据能稳健定位临界线，但沿线选取的具体点确定较弱；计算所得的维度在临界线其他位置最接近bootstrap结果。

title: Néel-Vector-Dependent Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in the One-Dimensional Limit
summary: Altermagnetism is normally identified by nonrelativistic spin-split bands in a compensated collinear magnet. Under one-dimensional confinement, however, this diagnostic can disappear: a boundary-compatible sublattice-exchange operation may leave the only Bloch momentum unchanged, forcing the nonrelativistic spin-up and spin-down spectra to coincide. We show that nonrelativistic spin degeneracy can coexist with relativistic spin splitting in a compensated one-dimensional magnet. In a Lieb-based construction, confinement along the diagonal cancels the projected $d$-wave spin splitting while preserving the real-space sublattice-exchange motif. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) then locks spin to the lattice, so the Néel-vector orientation selects a magnetic line group that can reveal spin-split bands. Using fully compensated $[110]$ Ta$_2$TeSeO nanoribbons as a prototype, we find spin-degenerate nonrelativistic bands and sizable SOC splitting in the inherited easy-axis domain, $\mathbf N\parallel[100]$ or $[010]$. For sufficiently wide ribbons that retain the parent easy-axis order, this splitting is an equilibrium property. The easy-axis ribbon also supports a right-moving-mode spin polarization of about $35\%$ at finite ideal conductance. Our results establish one-dimensional fully compensated altermagnetic functionality hidden inside apparently conventional antiferromagnetic bands.

AI.tldr: 在补偿共线磁体的一维限制下，非相对论性自旋劈裂可能消失而保持自旋简并，但SOC仍可产生相对论性自旋劈裂，实现隐藏于常规反铁磁能带中的一维补偿交替磁性功能。
AI.motivation: 交替磁性通常以补偿共线磁体中的非相对论性自旋劈裂能带为判据，但在一维限制下该判据可能失效：边界兼容的子格交换操作可保持唯一Bloch动量不变，迫使自旋向上/向下非相对论谱重合，从而掩盖交替磁性本质。
AI.method: 基于Lieb型构造，沿对角线方向限制纳米带以抵消投影的d波自旋劈裂，同时保留实空间子格交换模式；再引入自旋轨道耦合(SOC)使自旋锁定于晶格，由Néel矢量取向选择磁线群。以完全补偿的[110] Ta₂TeSeO纳米带为原型进行第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 在继承的易轴畴(N∥[100]或[010])中，发现非相对论能带自旋简并但存在显著SOC劈裂；对足够宽、保留母体易轴序的纳米带，该劈裂是平衡态性质。易轴纳米带在有限理想电导下支持约35%的右移模式自旋极化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明一维完全补偿交替磁性可隐藏于看似常规的反铁磁能带中，拓展了交替磁性的判据与一维器件功能。

title: Interplay of spin-lattice and electronic coupling far above Neel ordering in 2D antiferromagnetic CrPS4 and its interface manifestation
summary: A short-range spin correlation driven, strongly intercoupled spin-phonon-electronic state far above TN (~38K) is identified in the low dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4. Temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy reveals spin-phonon coupling persisting up to T*~120K, concomitant with local lattice distortion. The setting of vibronic progression in photoluminescence spectra suggests the strengthening of electron-phonon coupling around T*. Furthermore, both the electrical transport and optoelectronic response also change significantly at T*. The results indicate that spin-phonon coupling above TN in CrPS4 originates from local lattice distortion induced by short range magnetic correlations which in turn enhances the electron-phonon interaction. Furthermore, using a CrPS4/In2Se3 heterostructure, we demonstrate that the anomaly associated with the coupled degrees of freedom in CrPS4 also influences the adjacent In2Se3 layer. The lattice dynamics of In2Se3 is significantly modified across the magnetic anomaly of CrPS4, and the coupled dynamics is observed at T*. These interfacial manifestation opens up new possibilities for achieving correlated multifunctionalities in artificially designed heterostructure.

AI.tldr: 在低维范德华反铁磁体CrPS4中，发现远高于奈尔温度TN(~38K)的强自旋-声子-电子耦合态，源于短程磁关联诱导的局域晶格畸变。
AI.motivation: 探究低维反铁磁体中远高于磁有序温度的自旋-声子耦合起源，以及该耦合态能否通过异质结构界面调控邻近材料的物性。
AI.method: 温度依赖拉曼光谱、光致发光光谱（振动进展）、电输运与光电响应测量，并结合CrPS4/In2Se3异质结构研究界面耦合动力学。
AI.result: CrPS4中自旋-声子耦合持续至T*~120K并伴随局域晶格畸变，T*附近电子-声子耦合增强，电输运与光电响应显著变化；异质结构中In2Se3晶格动力学在CrPS4磁异常处被显著调制，耦合动力学出现在T*。
AI.conclusion: CrPS4中高于TN的自旋-声子耦合源于短程磁关联诱导的局域晶格畸变，进而增强电子-声子相互作用，并可通过异质界面传递给邻近层，为人工异质结构中实现关联多功能性提供新途径。

title: Acoustic Wave-Function Imaging of Sublattice Physics in a Kagome Lattice
summary: The canonical kagome band structure hosts a Dirac cone, saddle-point van Hove singularities (vHS), and a flat band. Characteristically, these features exhibit distinct sublattice localization within the three-site basis of the kagome lattice. However, experimental proof of this sublattice character is challenging and requires direct access to both the real-space wave function and its associated momentum-space texture. Here, we implement an acoustic kagome lattice on the cm scale and measure the full excitation spectrum, thereby imaging the wave function at each lattice site, including both amplitude and phase. This enables investigation of the momentum-dependent sublattice texture across the complete band structure, particularly at the flat band and at the mixed- and pure-sublattice van Hove singularities. Our results are in excellent agreement with minimal tight-binding model calculations and constitutes the first direct experimental observation of the sublattice-resolved band structure in a kagome lattice.

AI.tldr: 在厘米尺度声学kagome晶格上测量完整激发谱，成像各格点波函数（振幅与相位），首次直接观测kagome晶格的子晶格分辨能带结构。
AI.motivation: kagome能带具有Dirac锥、鞍点van Hove奇点与平带，并在三站点基下呈现不同子晶格局域性，但此前缺乏对实空间波函数及其动量空间纹理的直接实验验证。
AI.method: 搭建厘米尺度声学kagome晶格，测量全激发谱，逐格点成像波函数振幅与相位，从而提取动量依赖的子晶格纹理，并与最小紧束缚模型计算对比。
AI.result: 成功获得完整能带中的子晶格纹理，特别是平带及混合/纯子晶格van Hove奇点处，实验结果与紧束缚模型高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次在kagome晶格中实现对子晶格分辨能带结构的直接实验观测，为相关拓扑与关联物态研究提供平台。

title: Bridging steady-state and time-domain descriptions of molecular electron transport
summary: Electron transmission from an input electrode, through a molecular system, to an output electrode has been widely studied using the steady-state non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) method. Recently, the wave packet method, which provides access to the transient dynamics of electrons as well as internal molecular degrees of freedom, has been employed to investigate enantiospecific electron transport through chiral molecules. In this work, we derive the quantitative relation between the transmission of a finite-size wave packet and the energy-resolved NEGF transmission, showing that the former corresponds to a spectral average of the latter weighted by the wave packet energy distribution. Exploiting this correspondence, we construct non-Gaussian auxiliary wave packets whose spectral weight encodes the Landauer energy-window, allowing current-voltage characteristics to be obtained directly from time propagation. We further show that the correspondence extends to spin-resolved transport in a spin-phonon model of chirality-induced spin selectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限尺寸波包透射与NEGF能量分辨透射之间的定量关系，指出前者是后者按波包能量分布的谱平均，并据此构造辅助波包直接获得I-V特性，推广到手性诱导自旋选择体系。
AI.motivation: 电子从输入电极经分子系统到输出电极的传输常用稳态NEGF研究，而波包方法能获取瞬态动力学及分子内部自由度信息，但两者关系尚缺乏定量联系，需要建立对应以结合各自优势。
AI.method: 推导有限尺寸波包透射与能量分辨NEGF透射的定量关系，证明其为按波包能量分布的谱平均；利用该对应构造非高斯辅助波包，使其谱权重编码Landauer能量窗口；并推广到自旋-声子模型中的自旋分辨输运。
AI.result: 波包透射对应NEGF透射的谱平均；所构造的辅助波包可编码Landauer能量窗口，从而通过时间传播直接得到电流-电压特性；该对应关系可扩展到手性诱导自旋选择的自旋-声子模型中的自旋分辨输运。
AI.conclusion: 研究连接了波包方法与稳态NEGF框架，提供了一种用时间传播直接计算I-V特性及自旋分辨输运的途径，有助于研究瞬态和分子自由度相关的手性电子传输。

title: Correlation enhanced altermagnetism mediated by spin-lattice coupling in CrSb
summary: Altermagnets (AMs) exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, making them promising platforms for spintronic applications. While the symmetry and multipolar origins of nonrelativistic altermagnetic spin splitting (NRASS) are well established, the role of electronic correlations and spin-lattice coupling (SLC) in controlling NRASS remain unexplored. In particular, SLC provides a direct pathway for tuning altermagnetism through lattice degrees of freedom. Here we first investigate the role of electronic correlations on altermagnetic strength in NiAs-type material CrSb using density functional theory (DFT), DFT+$U$, and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that increasing electronic correlations substantially enhance NRASS and drive the stabilization of an incommensurate spin-spiral (SS) state, while dynamical correlations further amplify the spin splitting through quasiparticle renormalization of the Cr-$3d$ states. We find that the NRASS remains 12.5\% larger in DFT+DMFT than in DFT. By evaluating SLC in next step, we establish its direct connection to the evolution of NRASS and identify SLC as a microscopic descriptor between electronic correlation and enhanced altermagnetism in CrSb. Investigating it in another NiAs-type compound MnTe, we show that the SLC-NRASS correlation is generic across AMs and establish SLC as a microscopic descriptor of altermagnetic strength. Our results provide a unified framework for tuning altermagnetism through the interplay between the electronic correlations and lattice degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电子关联与自旋-晶格耦合(SLC)对CrSb交替磁体非相对论性交替磁自旋劈裂(NRASS)的调控作用，发现关联效应显著增强NRASS并驱动螺旋态，SLC可作为交替磁强度的微观描述符。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体的对称性和多极起源已明确，但电子关联与自旋-晶格耦合对NRASS的调控作用尚未被探索，而SLC可通过晶格自由度直接调控交替磁性。
AI.method: 采用DFT、DFT+U和DFT+DMFT研究NiAs型CrSb中电子关联对交替磁强度的影响，随后评估SLC并检验其在另一NiAs型化合物MnTe中的普适性。
AI.result: 电子关联增强NRASS并驱动非公度螺旋态稳定，动态关联通过Cr-3d准粒子重整化进一步放大劈裂；DFT+DMFT中NRASS比DFT大12.5%，SLC与NRASS演化直接相关且在MnTe中同样成立。
AI.conclusion: SLC被确立为电子关联与增强交替磁性之间的微观描述符，为通过电子关联与晶格自由度相互作用调控交替磁性提供了统一框架。

title: Unraveling the Kagome Antiferromagnetic $3J$ Model and Its Materials: An Integrated Approach
summary: We investigate the ground-state and finite-temperature properties of the kagome antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model with three inequivalent couplings, dubbed the 3J model, which is designed for the candidate Dirac quantum spin liquid (QSL) material YCu$_3$(OH)$_6$Br$_2$[Br$_{1-x}$(OH)$_x$] (see, e.g., Zeng et al., 2024). Employing large-scale density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) supplemented by neural quantum states (NQS) simulations, we identify an intermediate QSL phase between two magnetically ordered phases. We also find that this QSL is separated from the kagome spin liquid ground state at the isotropic limit. To establish a direct comparison with experiments, we compute the specific heat of the model by means of advanced exponential (XTRG) and tangent-space (tanTRG) thermal tensor-network methods. In the magnetically ordered phase, the specific heat over temperature exhibits a shoulder at a temperature that is a fraction of the coupling strength $J_{hex}$, which disappears in the QSL phase. These universal behaviors are consistent with the experimentally observed specific heat in 3J materials for both ordered and QSL candidate samples. Our work thus connects microscopic models with experimentally measurable signatures, exemplifying an integrated approach (see Meng et al., 2026) to understanding QSL phenomena in frustrated quantum magnets, with 3J materials serving as a representative case and providing a foundation for future studies.

AI.tldr: 本文用DMRG、NQS及热张量网络方法研究kagome反铁磁3J模型的基态与有限温度性质，发现两个磁序相之间存在一个中间量子自旋液体(QSL)相，其比热行为与YCu3(OH)6Br2[Br1-x(OH)x]的实验一致，为3J材料中的QSL现象提供了微观模型与实验联系的整合研究。
AI.motivation: 针对候选Dirac量子自旋液体材料YCu3(OH)6Br2[Br1-x(OH)x]（3J材料），需要在微观模型层面理解其基态与有限温度性质，并建立与可测量实验信号的直接联系。
AI.method: 采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群(DMRG)，辅以神经网络量子态(NQS)模拟，研究含三个不等价耦合的kagome反铁磁Heisenberg模型(3J模型)；并用先进的指数(XTRG)与切空间(tanTRG)热张量网络方法计算比热。
AI.result: 在两个磁有序相之间识别出一个中间QSL相，且该QSL与各向同性极限下的kagome自旋液体基态相分离。磁序相的比热在约J_hex的几分之一处出现肩部，该特征在QSL相中消失，与3J材料有序及QSL候选样品的实验比热一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将微观模型与实验可测信号关联，展示了理解阻挫量子磁体中QSL现象的整合方法，以3J材料为代表案例，为未来研究奠定基础。

title: Interplay of Kekulé order, flat bands and electron-phonon coupling in graphene
summary: The Kekulé order in graphene is known to give rise to extended flat bands near the van Hove singularity (VHS) and enhanced electron-phonon coupling. However, the microscopic mechanism underlying the coexistence of these effects remains unclear. Here, it is shown that they jointly emerge as a consequence of the lattice distortion manifested through the differentiation of carbon bonds and associated electronic hoppings. In this picture, the conduction band around the $M$ point decreases almost linearly in width with increasing Kekulé order, while the VHS and dimensionless electron-phonon coupling exhibit approximately quadratic upward responses. The resulting enhancement of the electron-phonon coupling is governed predominantly by the increasing density of states at the VHS, with the effective deformation potential remaining weakly affected by the distortion. As such, the obtained results are consistent with previous related theoretical and experimental studies, while also pointing toward a potential shallowing of the conduction band under the characteristic $1/4$ filling and an increasing relevance of nonadiabatic electron-phonon effects beyond the conventional Migdal approximation. Altogether, these findings highlight the potential of controlled Kekulé ordering for engineering emergent correlated quantum phases in graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示石墨烯中Kekulé序如何通过晶格畸变同时产生平坦能带与增强的电子-声子耦合，并提出其微观机制。
AI.motivation: Kekulé序已知会在范霍夫奇点附近产生扩展平带并增强电子-声子耦合，但二者共存的微观机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 通过分析Kekulé序引起的碳键差异及相应电子跃迁变化，即晶格畸变，来研究能带结构演化（包括M点附近导带宽度、VHS及无量纲电子-声子耦合）。
AI.result: 导带宽度随Kekulé序近似线性减小，而VHS和无量纲电子-声子耦合呈近似二次方上升；电子-声子耦合的增强主要源于VHS处态密度增加，有效形变势受畸变影响较弱。结果与已有理论和实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现指出1/4填充下导带可能变浅，以及超越Migdal近似的非绝热电子-声子效应的重要性，并表明受控Kekulé序可用于工程化石墨烯中的关联量子相。

title: Anisotropy of Ultrafast Strain in $V_2O_3$ Thin Films: Out-of-Equilibrium Phase Transitions under Interfacial Clamping
summary: Ultrafast photoinduced insulator-to-metal transitions in correlated materials are often mediated by lattice distortions, yet the role of interfacial lattice constraints in shaping nonequilibrium pathways remains largely unexplored. We use azimuth-resolved time-resolved X-ray diffraction to track orientation-dependent strain dynamics in granular V$_2$O$_3$ thin films on c-cut sapphire, where thermal-expansion mismatch imposes anisotropic interfacial strain. Across the thermal transition, the azimuthal profile of the (110)$_H$ strain inverts curvature, providing direct evidence of partial clamping of the hexagonal basal-plane lattice (a$_H$,b$_H$). After photoexcitation of the antiferromagnetic insulating phase, the structural response remains clamp-limited: weakly constrained grain families reach the full basal-plane contraction characteristic of the metallic-like state, whereas strongly constrained families exhibit a strongly reduced distortion. Fluence-dependent measurements further disentangle transformed fraction from clamping-limited lattice distortion. Our results show that interfacial clamping acts as a static selector for ultrafast phase switching and provide a general route to quantify anisotropic strain dynamics in heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 界面夹持作为静态选择器调控V₂O₃薄膜中超快光致相变路径。
AI.motivation: 关联材料的超快光致绝缘体-金属相变常由晶格畸变介导，但界面晶格约束如何影响非平衡相变路径尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用方位分辨时间分辨X射线衍射，追踪c切蓝宝石上V₂O₃颗粒薄膜中取向依赖的应变动力学。
AI.result: (110)_H应变随方位角分布曲率反转，表明六方基面晶格被部分夹持；弱约束晶粒达完全基面收缩，强约束晶粒畸变大幅减弱；变通量测量分离出相变分数与夹持限制畸变。
AI.conclusion: 界面夹持静态选择超快相切换，为量化异质结构各向异性应变动力学提供通用途径。

title: Learning Quantum Matter through Attention in Complex Space
summary: Magnetic many-electron wavefunctions require amplitude and phase to be optimized together. Whether a complex internal representation improves this variational search is a practical question for neural wavefunction design. We introduce Complex Psiformer for interacting electrons in a magnetic moiré continuum, combining complex hidden features and Hermitian-magnitude attention with magnetic boundary conditions and fermionic antisymmetry. After the same number of optimization steps, Complex Psiformer reaches lower energies than Real Psiformer in two finite supercells. Both Psiformers also improve on their respective neural Hartree-Fock references. Across five training seeds in the 25-cell system, the mean Complex advantage is 1.458 meV per electron, with a smaller observed spread. A separately trained two-electron Complex state has a smaller energy gap to a finite configuration interaction reference than its Real counterpart. In the Complex states, flux scans show nonmonotonic density correlations and weaker honeycomb mean-density modulation at higher flux, while connected fluctuations persist. Gauge invariant current maps provide a qualitative comparison of local circulation in the optimized states. These benchmarks support the combined architecture as a variational ansatz for studying energies and charge arrangements in finite magnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Complex Psiformer 神经网络波函数，用于磁性 moiré 连续体中相互作用电子，通过复隐藏特征与 Hermitian 幅度注意力提升变分搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 磁性多电子波函数需同时优化振幅与相位，复内表示是否能改善变分搜索是神经网络波函数设计中的实际问题。
AI.method: 结合复隐藏特征、Hermitian 幅度注意力、磁边界条件与费米子反对称性，构建 Complex Psiformer；与 Real Psiformer 及各自神经 Hartree-Fock 参考对比。
AI.result: 相同优化步数下，Complex Psiformer 在两个有限超胞中能量更低；25 格系统五个随机种子平均优势为每电子 1.458 meV 且方差更小；双电子复态与有限组态相互作用参考的能隙更小；通量扫描显示非单调密度关联、高磁通下蜂窝平均密度调制减弱及持续连通涨落。
AI.conclusion: 该联合架构可作为研究有限磁系统能量与电荷分布的变分拟设。

title: Hilbert-space selected switch of helical edges in an artificial quantum Hall insulator
summary: Quantum Hall effects (QHE) host one-dimensional topologically-protected edge channels, which can serve as an essential ingredient in exotic quantum electronic systems. Yet the manual reconstruction of Landau-level topology, by electrostatic confinement or symmetry breaking, remains experimentally challenging. Here, we show that interfacial charge transfer in between CrOCl and large-angle twisted bilayer graphene offsets the two otherwise decoupled Dirac Landau-level ladders in each graphene layer, creating a new sequence of composite filling configurations. At charge neutrality, the composited $(+2,-2)$ state involves only the zeroth Landau levels and becomes fully insulating, with longitudinal resistance reaching the G$Ω$ regime. By contrast, higher composite zero-filling quantum Hall states, including $(+6,-6)$ and $(+10,-10)$, retain counter-propagating helical edge channels and exhibit pronounced non-local transport, reaching up to $50\%$ of the local response. We attribute such switching-behavior to the Landau-spinor Hilbert space -- as the filling is reduced from $(+6,-6)$ to $(+2,-2)$, the orthogonal $N=\pm1$ orbital components are removed, eliminating the edge-compatible channel and gapping both bulk and boundary transport. The interaction nature of the observed gapped sates was further examined both experimentally and theoretically. Our results suggest that charge transfer provides a direct route to engineer artificial quantum Hall insulators, opening possibilities for wavefunction-selective control of helical edge modes.

AI.tldr: 通过在CrOCl与大角度扭转双层石墨烯间界面电荷转移，实现复合朗道能级填充态，调控边缘通道与绝缘行为。
AI.motivation: 量子霍尔效应的边缘通道是关键，但人工重构朗道能级拓扑（通过静电约束或对称破缺）实验上仍然困难。
AI.method: 利用CrOCl与双层石墨烯间界面电荷转移，错开两层石墨烯解耦的狄拉克朗道能级阶梯，形成复合填充配置；测量电输运（纵向电阻、非局域输运），并实验与理论结合分析能隙态的相互作用性质。
AI.result: 电中性处复合(+2,-2)态仅涉及第零朗道能级，完全绝缘，纵向电阻达GΩ量级；(+6,-6)和(+10,-10)等更高复合零填充态保留反向传播螺旋边缘通道，非局域输运达局域响应50%；填充降低时N=±1轨道分量被移除，消除边缘兼容通道并打开体态与边界能隙。
AI.conclusion: 电荷转移为工程化人工量子霍尔绝缘体提供直接途径，并为螺旋边缘模式的波函数选择性控制开辟可能。

title: Interacting Tomonaga-Lüttinger liquid with impurity for interaction constant $K = 1/2$: Thermopower investigation, entropy variation and heat capacity densities associated with thermoelectric particle transport
summary: We investigate thermoelectric and thermodynamic properties of a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid with interaction parameter $K=1/2$ in the presence of a localized impurity. Using bosonization and refermionization, we derive an exact expression for the thermopower in the nonlinear regime and obtain the corresponding Seebeck coefficient in linear response. At low temperature, the Seebeck coefficient follows a Mott-like relation governed by the energy dependence of the transmission coefficient and is found to be closely related to the entropy per particle. This connection allows us to derive using Kelvin formula the thermopower contribution to the entropy density variation and the charge-carriers contribution to the heat capacity density. Both quantities exhibit Mott-like behavior in the low-temperature regime. We apply our results to a fractional quantum Hall quantum point contact and to a one-channel quantum conductor coupled to an Ohmic environment. Our results demonstrate the close connection between thermoelectric transport and thermodynamic properties in interacting one-dimensional quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 研究带局域杂质的 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体（K=1/2）的热电与热力学性质，用玻色化/费米化得到非线性热电势与线性 Seebeck 系数，并与熵、热容建立联系。
AI.motivation: 探究相互作用一维量子系统中热电输运与热力学性质的深层联系，特别是 Mott 型热电行为与熵、载流子热容之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用玻色化与 refermionization 方法，推导非线性区热电势的精确表达式及线性响应下的 Seebeck 系数；利用 Kelvin 公式将热电势与熵密度变化、电荷载流子热容密度关联。
AI.result: 低温下 Seebeck 系数遵循 Mott 型关系，由透射系数的能量依赖决定，并与每粒子熵密切相关；热电势对熵密度变化和热容密度的贡献均呈 Mott 型行为。结果应用于分数量子霍尔量子点接触和耦合 Ohm 环境的一通道量子导体。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了相互作用一维量子系统中热电输运与热力学性质的紧密联系。

title: Bottom-up Synthesis of Metastable 2D Hexagonal Copper(I) Iodide on Monolayer and within Bilayer Graphene
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, Includes Supporting Information with 5 figures and 7 tables
summary: Copper(I) iodide (CuI) is a wide-bandgap semiconductor crystallizing in the 3D $γ$-phase under ambient conditions; its layered van der Waals bulk phase $β$-CuI is stable only between 643 and 673 K. The two-dimensional (2D) h-CuI form has been obtained via liquid-phase exfoliation of mechanochemically prepared precursors and via encapsulation between graphene sheets, whereas bottom-up growth of 2D h-CuI on open surfaces has not yet been demonstrated. Here, we report a vapor-phase synthesis of h-CuI directly on low-defect, large-area monolayer and within bilayer reduced oxo-graphene (r-oxo-G) at low temperatures. Using a copper TEM grid as the solid-state precursor for copper, HI-vapor exposure at 40 $°$C initiates nucleation, while annealing at 180 $°$C promotes the growth of extended h-CuI domains. Aberration-corrected HRTEM resolves the atomic structure, local twist angles, and lattice anisotropy of the CuI/r-oxo-G nanohybrid, while STEM-EDX yields a Cu:I ratio consistent with 1:1. First-principles calculations show that van der Waals adhesion to graphene stabilizes the supported hexagonal layer. Under the presented low-temperature precursor conditions, pathways for nucleation of the $γ$-phase are not available, allowing the hexagonal phase to form selectively at the graphene interface. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations show that the heterostructure retains its hexagonal lattice order at 600 K, including on an open monolayer graphene support. The lateral extent of the growth is limited mainly by remaining interfacial adsorbates. These results establish a route to metastable 2D h-CuI on a chemically inert graphene template, which may be useful for wide-bandgap electronic and optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了在低温下直接在低缺陷、大面积单层及双层还原氧化石墨烯(r-oxo-G)上气相合成二维六方相碘化铜(h-CuI)的方法，突破了此前仅能通过液相剥离或石墨烯夹层获得2D h-CuI的限制。
AI.motivation: CuI在常温下稳定于3D γ相，层状β相仅在643–673 K稳定；此前2D h-CuI只能通过液相剥离或石墨烯夹层获得，尚无法在开放表面自下而上生长，因此需要一种在惰性衬底上选择性生长亚稳2D h-CuI的途径。
AI.method: 以铜TEM网格作为固态铜源，在40 °C下通入HI蒸气引发成核，180 °C退火促进h-CuI畴区生长；结合像差校正HRTEM解析原子结构、扭转角与晶格各向异性，STEM-EDX确定Cu:I≈1:1，并用第一性原理与从头算分子动力学模拟研究界面稳定性与热稳定性。
AI.result: 成功在r-oxo-G上直接气相生长出延伸的h-CuI畴区；HRTEM解析了CuI/r-oxo-G纳米杂化体的原子结构与局部扭转角；Cu:I比接近1:1；计算表明范德华吸附稳定了六方层，低温前驱体条件下γ相成核路径不可行，从而实现六方相在界面处选择性形成；AIMD显示异质结构在600 K（含开放单层石墨烯支撑）仍保持六方晶格有序；生长横向尺寸主要受残余界面吸附物限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在化学惰性石墨烯模板上生长亚稳2D h-CuI的路线，有望用于宽禁带电子与光电子器件。

title: Sub-cycle doublon-holon dynamics in one-dimensional Mott insulators revealed by two-color high-harmonic spectroscopy
summary: Solid-state high-harmonic spectroscopy is becoming an emerging tool for probing nonequilibrium many-body dynamics. Yet, direct measurements of strongly driven, sub-optical-cycle dynamics in correlated materials during high-harmonic emission remain largely unexplored. Here, we measure high-harmonic emission chirp in a prototypical one-dimensional Mott insulator, which encodes strongly driven doublon-holon dynamics at sub-optical-cycle timescales. We observe a positive chirp for above band gap harmonics, indicating that high harmonics are dominated by doublon-holon recombinations. We further show a harmonic order-dependent dephasing, which can be understood through different doublon-holon excursion distances associated with each harmonic. These results reveal coherent doublon-holon dynamics and their ultrafast dephasing in Mott insulators, which is relevant to other nonequilibrium light-induced phenomena, such as Floquet engineering.

AI.tldr: 通过测量一维Mott绝缘体的高次谐波发射啁啾，揭示了亚光学周期尺度的强驱动doublon-holon动力学及其谐波级次依赖的退相位。
AI.motivation: 固态高次谐波谱学是探测非平衡多体动力学的新兴工具，但关联材料中强驱动、亚光学周期动力学过程的高次谐波直接测量尚属空白。
AI.method: 测量典型一维Mott绝缘体的高次谐波发射啁啾，探测强驱动的doublon-holon动力学。
AI.result: 带隙以上谐波呈正啁啾，表明由doublon-holon复合主导；并观测到谐波级次依赖的退相位，可由不同谐波对应不同doublon-holon偏移距离解释。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了Mott绝缘体中相干doublon-holon动力学及其超快退相位，与其他非平衡光致现象（如Floquet工程）相关。

title: Low temperature thermodynamics of $S_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ triangular lattice quantum spin liquid candidate TlYbS$_2$
summary: Geometrically frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets exhibit a delicate competition between magnetic order and quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior, with the Yb-based delafossite family $A$Yb$X_2$ providing a structurally clean platform for exploring this physics. Here, we report a comprehensive study of single-crystal TlYbS$_2$ using DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements extending from room temperature to the millikelvin regime. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms a trigonal $R\bar{3}m$ structure comprising well-separated triangular layers of Yb$^{3+}$ ions with no detectable site disorder. At zero field, a weak thermodynamic anomaly is observed near $530$ mK, which may indicate the onset of a weakly ordered state similar to that reported in KYbSe$_2$. Below $300$ mK, the zero-field magnetic specific heat follows $C_{\rm m}\propto T^{1.8}$, close to a quadratic temperature dependence, in contrast to the linear temperature dependence reported for the sister compound TlYbSe$_2$, which has been described in terms of the interplay between spinons and thermally excited gauge-flux excitations. Magnetization and ESR measurements establish pronounced easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, with $g_\perp/g_\parallel \approx 6.9$. The anomaly near $530$ mK exhibits a strongly anisotropic response to magnetic field. For $H\perp c$, it remains visible up to approximately $2$ T and continuously evolves toward a field-induced ordered phase above approximately $2.5$ T, followed by a sequence of field-induced phases that includes a $1/3$ magnetization plateau between approximately $5$ and $8$ T and full polarization near $17$ T. In contrast, for $H\parallel c$, the anomaly weakens and is suppressed near $3$ T, consistent with the recently reported confinement--deconfinement transition from an ordered state to a field-induced QSL.

AI.tldr: 单晶TlYbS2的综合研究揭示其低温磁行为，零场下530 mK出现弱有序异常，低温比热近T^1.8，并展现出强易面各向异性及丰富的场诱导相。
AI.motivation: 三角晶格反铁磁体中磁有序与量子自旋液体(QSL)的竞争是凝聚态物理的重要问题，Yb基delafossite家族AYbX2提供了结构洁净的研究平台，本文旨在探索TlYbS2的这一物理。
AI.method: 采用单晶X射线衍射确认结构，结合直流磁化率、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振(ESR)和比热测量，温度范围从室温到毫开尔文。
AI.result: 结构为三角R-3m、Yb3+三角层无位点无序；零场下530 mK出现弱热力学异常；300 mK以下零场磁比热Cm∝T^1.8（近二次），不同于TlYbSe2的线性行为；强易面各向异性g⊥/g∥≈6.9；异常对磁场强各向异性：H⊥c时保持至~2 T，~2.5 T以上演化为场诱导有序相，出现1/3磁化平台(~5–8 T)及~17 T完全极化；H∥c时异常减弱并在~3 T被抑制，与有序态到场诱导QSL的限域-去限域转变一致。
AI.conclusion: TlYbS2展现出与TlYbSe2不同的低温比热行为及丰富的场诱导相图，为研究三角晶格中磁有序与QSL竞争及限域-去限域转变提供了新平台。

title: Skyrmion nucleus resolves the Landauer paradox
summary: Ferroelectric switching is among the most fundamental and widely studied symmetry-breaking processes in physics. However, the Landauer paradox asserts that an ideal single-domain ferroelectric should be kinetically unswitchable, because a three-dimensional reversed nucleus would carry a prohibitive depolarization penalty, leading to unphysically large coercive field (the electric field required to switch the polarization). Here we show that this long-standing paradox is resolved by topology. In defect-free PbTiO3, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the intrinsic critical nucleus is a three-dimensional polar skyrmion. Its continuous polarization rotation and Néel-type boundary walls self-compensate bound charge, suppressing the depolarization energy by orders of magnitude and bringing the predicted coercive field into agreement with experiment. This topological nucleus further overturns the 60-year-old Janovec-Kay-Dunn law. We derive an analytical thickness-dependent coercive-field law governed by field-induced softening of the parent ferroelectric state and controlled by a single material descriptor. This framework captures diverse experimental trends across ferroelectric families and recasts the Kay-Dunn exponent of -2/3 as an effective finite-window behavior. These results establish polar topology as an organizing principle for intrinsic switching and suggest that hidden topological transition states may broadly shape nonequilibrium phase transformations traditionally understood as Landau-type symmetry breaking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拓扑学解决了铁电体Landauer悖论，发现本征临界核是三维极性skyrmion，并推导出新的矫顽场定律。
AI.motivation: Landauer悖论指出理想单畴铁电体在动力学上不可翻转，因为三维反转核会带来巨大的退极化惩罚，导致矫顽场异常巨大。这一长期悖论亟待解决。
AI.method: 在无缺陷PbTiO3中，采用大规模分子动力学模拟研究本征临界核的拓扑结构。
AI.result: 本征临界核是三维极性skyrmion，其连续极化旋转和Néel型边界壁可自补偿束缚电荷，将退极化能量降低数个数量级，使预测矫顽场与实验一致。该拓扑核还推翻了60年的Janovec-Kay-Dunn定律。
AI.conclusion: 推导出由母铁电态场致软化控制、单一材料描述符决定的厚度依赖矫顽场解析定律，该框架统一了多种铁电体系的实验趋势，并将Kay-Dunn指数-2/3重新解释为有效有限窗口行为。极性拓扑成为本征翻转的组织原则，隐藏的拓扑过渡态可能广泛影响非平衡相变。

title: Effect of Stress and Surface Roughness on Electrodeposition in All-Solid-State Batteries: A Computational Investigation
summary: All-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) promise high energy density and enhanced safety, but their development is hindered by instability and incompatibility at solid-solid interfaces. In Li-metal ASSBs, lithium penetration occurs despite stiff ceramic electrolytes via grain boundaries, often initiated by minor Li/SE interfacial irregularities. Here we introduce a two-dimensional continuum model with electro-chemo-mechanical coupling to investigate interfacial current distribution in Li ASSBs with surface-roughened argyrodite electrolyte under stack pressures and applied current density. Our theoretical analysis and simulation studies highlight the critical role of mechanical stress in interfacial current distribution. We find that prominent stress variations around elongated surface protrusions are the key to nonuniform Li deposition, without which Li deposition becomes uniform even on a rough surface. Moreover, our parametric study elucidates that stress effects dominate the overpotential and current distribution under low interfacial current density to exchange current density ratios, otherwise the high interfacial resistance due to surface-roughness-induced interfacial area becomes dominant. With these insights, we also discuss the potential of engineering artificial interlayers to modulate interfacial current distributions, offering guidance for improving the long-term performance and reliability of ASSBs.

AI.tldr: 本文建立二维电-化学-力学耦合连续模型，研究表面粗糙的硫银锗矿电解质在全固态锂电池中的界面电流分布。
AI.motivation: 全固态电池虽有高能量密度和安全性优势，但固-固界面不稳定与不兼容（如锂穿透）阻碍其发展，需要理解界面电流分布机理。
AI.method: 构建二维电-化学-力学耦合连续介质模型，模拟受堆叠压力和外加电流密度下表面粗糙化硫银锗矿电解质的界面电流分布，并进行参数化研究。
AI.result: 观察到细长表面凸起周围的显著应力变化是锂非均匀沉积的关键；若无应力效应，即使粗糙表面锂沉积也均匀；低界面电流密度/交换电流密度比时应力效应主导过电位与电流分布，否则表面粗糙导致的界面电阻占主导。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示力学应力在界面电流分布中的关键作用，并提出通过人工界面层工程调控界面电流分布，为提升全固态电池长期性能与可靠性提供指导。

title: High-throughput thermodynamic screening of oxide-scale adhesion across the CoCrFeMnNiAl high-entropy alloys
summary: One significant benefit of reactive element (RE) additions is the colossal improvement in oxide-scale retention during high-temperature oxidation. Selecting optimal RE dopants in high-entropy alloys remains empirical because the relevant thermodynamic landscape is inaccessible to first-principles at the required compositional resolution. Here we apply the macroscopic atom model, coupled with McLean isotherm and Guttmann models, to screen adhesion across nine CoCrFeMnNiAl sub-families at \ce{Cr2O3} and \ce{Al2O3} interfaces, ranking five REs (Hf, Y, Zr, La, Ti) for segregation, adhesion enhancement, and sulfur displacement. The screening reveals an oxide-dependent ranking inversion, with Hf dominating at \ce{Cr2O3} and La dominating at \ce{Al2O3}, driven by the interplay between RE--O and RE--matrix interaction enthalpies. Mn-containing alloys exhibit intrinsic sulfur resistance, consistent with their experimentally observed oxidation characteristics. A sulfur immunity phase diagram identifies compositions with Al~+~Mn~$\gtrsim$~25~at\% as thermodynamically immune to S-induced adhesion loss. All crossover concentrations collapse onto a universal exponential governed by the segregation enthalpy difference, providing a transferable design rule. Inverse design identifies \ce{Co16Cr16Fe16Ni16Al35} as the optimal S-immune composition with $W_\text{sep} = 5.95$~J/m$^2$ without RE doping.

AI.tldr: 本文用宏观原子模型结合McLean和Guttmann模型，在九类CoCrFeMnNiAl合金的Cr2O3和Al2O3界面上筛选RE掺杂，揭示界面依赖的排序反转并提出可迁移设计规则与最优成分。
AI.motivation: 高熵合金中活性元素（RE）掺杂优化仍依赖经验，因所需成分分辨率下的热力学图景无法用第一性原理获得。
AI.method: 采用宏观原子模型，耦合McLean等温线和Guttmann模型，对九类CoCrFeMnNiAl合金在Cr2O3和Al2O3界面进行偏聚、粘附增强和硫置换筛选，评估Hf、Y、Zr、La、Ti五种RE。
AI.result: 发现氧化物依赖的排序反转：Cr2O3界面Hf最优，Al2O3界面La最优，由RE–O与RE–基体相互作用焓竞争决定；含Mn合金具本征抗硫性与实验一致；硫免疫相图显示Al+Mn≳25 at%时热力学免疫；所有交叉浓度符合由偏聚焓差控制的普适指数规律；反设计得到Co16Cr16Fe16Ni16Al35，W_sep=5.95 J/m²且无需RE掺杂。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供可迁移的合金设计规则，并确定无需RE掺杂的S免疫最优成分。

title: Competition between vacancy creation and filling in defect-engineering of hBN
summary: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) has recently become the focus of intense research as a material that can host quantum emitters. It is known that such emission is related to point defects, but in order to conclusively correlate specific defects to their spectra, having control over the defect creation mechanism is required. Here, we prepare freestanding, monolayer hBN samples and irradiate them with ultra-low-energy (150 eV) Ar+ ions. The samples are characterized before and after irradiation via scanning transmission electron microscopy to assess the defect density and distribution. Contrary to what analytical potential molecular dynamics simulations have predicted, we predominantly observe boron single vacancies after ion irradiation, followed by double vacancies at half the count. Moreover, we also observe that vacancy filling with Si and C impurity atoms plays a more significant role in the created defects than previously assumed, potentially posing a problem for selective creation of quantum emitters in hBN.

AI.tldr: 本文通过超低能(150 eV) Ar+离子辐照单层hBN，并结合STEM表征，研究了缺陷的产生与分布。结果发现实际缺陷以硼单空位为主、双空位次之，与分子动力学模拟预测不符，且Si、C杂质填补空位的影响比预期更大。
AI.motivation: hBN可作为量子发射体宿主，其发光与点缺陷相关，但要确证特定缺陷与光谱的对应关系，必须先能控制缺陷的产生机制。因此需要实验研究离子辐照下缺陷的实际类型与分布。
AI.method: 制备自支撑单层hBN样品，用150 eV超低能Ar+离子进行辐照，并采用扫描透射电子显微镜(STEM)在辐照前后对样品进行表征，以评估缺陷密度与分布。
AI.result: 辐照后主要观察到硼单空位，双空位数量约为其一半，这与分析势分子动力学模拟的预测相反。此外还发现Si和C杂质原子填补空位在缺陷形成中比以往假设更显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验揭示了hBN中离子辐照缺陷的实际类型与分布，修正了理论模拟的预测，并指出杂质填补效应可能对在hBN中有选择性地制备量子发射体构成挑战。

title: Device Engineering and Performance Optimization of Cu2NiGeS4 Thin-Film Solar Cells with In2S3/MoTe2 Charge-Selective Layers: A Computational Study
summary: The pursuit of efficient and sustainable thin-film photovoltaics increasingly demands absorber materials that combine strong optical absorption with earth-abundant and environmentally benign constituents. Cu2NiGeS4 (CNGS) has emerged as a promising quaternary chalcogenide absorber owing to its favorable optoelectronic properties and high absorption coefficient, yet its photovoltaic potential remains comparatively underexplored, particularly in conjunction with optimized charge-selective layers. Here, we introduce and comprehensively investigate an CNGS-based solar-cell architecture using SCAPS-1D, with In2S3 and MoTe2 serving as the electron and hole-transport layers respectively. The analysis of energy-band profiles, electric fields, carrier distributions, and generation-recombination characteristics reveals the mechanisms governing carrier separation and extraction across the heterojunctions. Systematic optimization of layer thickness, doping density, bulk and interface defect densities, recombination coefficients, parasitic resistances, temperature, and illumination intensity identifies the key factors limiting device performance. The optimized device is predicted to achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 28.44% with a open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.984 V, short-circuit current density (JSC) of 34.39 mA/cm2, and fill factor (FF) of 84.04%, under AM1.5G illumination at 300 K. This simulated efficiency exceeds the previously reported 6.25-21.17% range for CNGS-based solar cells considered in this study. The findings establish In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2 as a promising platform for next-generation thin-film photovoltaics and provide physically grounded design guidelines for absorber optimization, interface engineering, and future experimental realization.

AI.tldr: 采用SCAPS-1D模拟In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2薄膜太阳能电池，优化后PCE达28.44%。
AI.motivation: Cu2NiGeS4(CNGS)具优异光电性能和吸收系数且元素丰富环保，但其光伏潜力及与优化电荷选择层的结合尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 用SCAPS-1D构建In2S3(电子传输层)/CNGS(吸收层)/MoTe2(空穴传输层)结构，分析能带、电场、载流子分布及产生-复合特性，并系统优化厚度、掺杂浓度、缺陷密度、复合系数、寄生电阻、温度和光照强度。
AI.result: 优化器件在AM1.5G、300K下PCE=28.44%，VOC=0.984V，JSC=34.39mA/cm2，FF=84.04%，超过此前报道的CNGS电池6.25-21.17%范围。
AI.conclusion: In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2是下一代薄膜光伏的有前景平台，为吸收层优化、界面工程和实验实现提供设计指导。

title: Piezomagnetism in a model cubic noncollinear altermagnet
summary: Altermagnets constitute a distinct class of magnetic materials that combine compensated magnetic order with spin-polarized electronic bands, hence carrying characteristics of both antiferromagnets and ferromagnets. Piezomagnetism - the linear relationship between lattice strain and a net magnetic moment - has emerged as smoking-gun evidence of altermagnetism that distinguishes it from antiferromagnetism. Here, we uncover a large piezomagnetic response in MnTe2, a cubic altermagnet with a noncollinear spin arrangement and weak spin-orbit coupling. We combine dilatometry with nuclear magnetic resonance, a bulk local probe, to observe signatures of both direct and inverse piezomagnetism consistent with symmetry considerations and first-principles calculations. The dilatometry measurements reveal a shear deformation proportional to an applied magnetic field, while magnetic resonance detects a ferromagnetic moment induced by shear strain. The respective results for the piezomagnetic coupling strength are in good agreement, and they are captured by first-principles results. These findings for simple binary MnTe2 position this material as a model altermagnet, demonstrate the utility of nuclear magnetic resonance in investigations of piezomagnetism, and open new avenues for multimodal strain and magnetic-field control in spintronic and memory applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文在立方交错磁体MnTe₂中发现巨大压磁响应，结合膨胀测量与核磁共振观测到正/逆压磁效应，与对称性和第一性原理计算一致。
AI.motivation: 压磁效应（晶格应变与净磁矩的线性关系）是区分交错磁体与反铁磁体的关键证据。作者希望寻找并验证一种能清晰展现此效应的模型交错磁体材料。
AI.method: 选择具有非共线自旋排列和弱自旋轨道耦合的立方交错磁体MnTe₂；结合膨胀测量（dilatometry）与核磁共振（NMR，体相局域探针）观测正压磁与逆压磁信号，并与对称性分析和第一性原理计算对比。
AI.result: 膨胀测量显示剪切形变正比于外加磁场；磁共振检测到剪切应变诱导的铁磁矩。两种方法得到的压磁耦合强度高度一致，并与第一性原理结果吻合。
AI.conclusion: MnTe₂作为一种简单二元化合物，是理想的模型交错磁体；核磁共振在压磁研究中具有实用价值，并为自旋电子学与存储应用中的多模态应变与磁场调控开辟了新途径。

title: High-Temperature ferromagnetism from site-selective filling in (Fe,Ni)$_{6-δ}$GeTe$_2$
summary: The discovery of high-temperature ferromagnetism in the metallic van der Waals (vdW) system Fe$_N$GeTe$_2$ has brought two-dimensional (2D) magnets into technologically relevant temperature scales. Specifically at N = 5, dilution of magnetic moments by nickel substitution counterintuitively achieves a record high Curie temperature of 478~K. Unraveling the origin of this nickel-substitution-induced enhancement is complicated by the compound's structural complexity, coexistent itinerant and local magnetic contributions, and mesoscopic compositional domains. Through coordinated structural and electronic characterization, we identify that the high-T$_C$ magnetic phase arises from a strain-stabilized Fe$_6$GeTe$_2$ nano-precipitate. Combining first-principles calculations and spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we uncover a site-specific electronic landscape in which interior iron atoms primarily host localized moments while the outer iron atoms neighboring the tellurium layers produce spin-polarized itinerant carriers that cross the vdW gap. The large energy cost associated with homogeneous nickel substitution is found to favor the spontaneous precipitation of the crystallographically and electronically ``clean'' high-T$_C$ phase. Finally, we compare metal-rich vdW magnets with binary magnetic alloys, and discuss the unifying roles of nano-precipitates in stabilizing otherwise unattainable bulk phases. Our work provides mechanistic insights into the record-high T$_C$ ferromagnetism in (Fe,Ni)$_{5+δ}$GeTe$_2$, establishing a rigorous foundation for the atomic engineering of vdW magnetic metals informed by direct electronic signatures.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示(Fe,Ni)₅₊δGeTe₂中创纪录高居里温度478 K源于应变稳定的Fe₆GeTe₂纳米析出相，而非均匀Ni替代，并阐明其位点分辨的电子结构机制。
AI.motivation: Fe_NGeTe₂是金属性vdW高温铁磁体，N=5时Ni替代反常地把T_C提升到478 K，但该增强机制受结构复杂、巡游与局域磁性共存、介观成分畴等因素困扰，亟需澄清。
AI.method: 结合结构与电子表征、第一性原理计算以及自旋分辨和角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)。
AI.result: 高T_C相来自应变稳定的Fe₆GeTe₂纳米析出物；内部Fe原子提供局域磁矩，邻近Te层的外部Fe原子产生穿越vdW间隙的自旋极化巡游载流子；均匀Ni替代的能量代价高，因而促使该"干净"高T_C相自发析出。
AI.conclusion: 将金属富集vdW磁体与二元磁性合金对比，指出纳米析出物在稳定原本不可达的体相中的统一作用，为vdW磁性金属的原子工程奠定机理基础。

title: Sparse data limit what a mechanistic corrosion model can predict
summary: Mechanistic corrosion models are routinely fitted with four to six parameters to a few measurements and extrapolated across service lifetimes, yet whether the data determine them is rarely tested. We identify a reduced point defect model for the duplex oxide on Nb-stabilized AISI 347 in simulated boiling-water-reactor water from published depth profiles at three exposure times, by differentiable inversion graded against a closed-form reference. Profile likelihood, a 1000-member bootstrap and a prior-relaxation test agree that one of the five parameters is undetermined and a second only weakly so, and that 95% of the fit statistic rests on three chromium points. The kinetics track an empirical power law over the calibration window but diverge from it by a factor of 3.5 to 6.3 at ten years, outside the propagated uncertainty band. That separation, not the thickness it brackets, is what these data determine; an exposure near 3000 hours would resolve it.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了机理腐蚀模型参数的可辨识性：五参数模型中有一个参数无法确定、另一个仅弱确定，且拟合统计量95%来自三个铬数据点；十年外推偏离经验幂律3.5–6.3倍，超出不确定度带。
AI.motivation: 机理腐蚀模型常以4–6个参数拟合少量测量并外推至服役寿命，但数据是否足以确定这些参数很少被检验。作者希望评估此类外推的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于已发表的三个暴露时间深度剖面，对模拟沸水堆水环境中Nb稳定化AISI 347双相氧化物的约化点缺陷模型进行可微反演，并以闭式参考解作梯度校验；结合剖面似然、1000次自助法和先验松弛检验评估参数可辨识性与拟合统计量来源。
AI.result: 五种参数中一个完全不可确定，另一个仅弱确定；拟合统计量的95%仅来自三个铬数据点。标定窗口内动力学符合经验幂律，但十年外推偏离该幂律3.5–6.3倍，超出传播不确定度带。数据实际确定的是这一偏离而非厚度区间；约3000小时暴露可分辨该偏离。
AI.conclusion: 腐蚀模型的长时外推可能缺乏数据支撑，应重视参数可辨识性与外推偏离的检验；补充约3000小时暴露实验可有效分辨动力学偏离。
